title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Hard Rock Live, Hollywood | 2025
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at Hard Rock Live, situated at the Seminole Hard Rock Hollywood in Hollywood, Florida, USA, on 20 June 2025.

It was the sixth show of the 16th All-Starr Band’s 2025 tour. Starr previously performed at the Hard Rock Live on 3 July 2008, 15 July 2010, 30 June 2012, and 17 September 2022. Paul McCartney also performed at the venue on 25 May 2022.

The 16th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Buck Johnson: vocals, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
